tables.text:
The two-way table shows the results of a survey of 200 students about whether they participate in a sport and whether they participate in a music program.

| | Sport | No Sport | Total |
|---|---|---|---|
| Music | 40 | 20 | 60 |
| No Music | 70 | 70 | 140 |
| Total | 110 | 90 | 200 |

A student is selected at random from those who participate in a sport. What is the probability that this student also participates in music?

The linear function $g$ is defined for all real numbers. The table below shows selected values of $g$.

| $x$ | $g(x)$ |
|---|---|
| $-2$ | $11$ |
| $1$ | $5$ |
| $4$ | $-1$ |

For what value of $x$ does $g(x) = 0$?

The table below shows data for five observations.

| $x$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ | $5$ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| $y$ | $3$ | $5$ | $8$ | $9$ | $15$ |

The line of best fit for the data is $y = 2.8x + 0.2$. What is the sum of the squared residuals for these five data points?

The linear function $g$ is defined for all real numbers. The table below shows selected values of $g(x)$.

| $x$ | $g(x)$ |
|---|---|
| $-2$ | $11$ |
| $1$ | $5$ |
| $4$ | $-1$ |

If $g(a) = 0$, what is the value of $a$?

The table below shows data for $300$ customers at a restaurant.

| | Ordered Dessert | Did Not Order Dessert | Total |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ordered Coffee | $45$ | $105$ | $150$ |
| Did Not Order Coffee | $30$ | $120$ | $150$ |
| Total | $75$ | $225$ | $300$ |

Given that a randomly selected customer ordered coffee, what is the probability that the customer also ordered dessert?

A company tested $400$ products for defects. The results are summarized in the table below.

| | Defective | Not Defective | Total |
|---|---|---|---|
| Factory X | $18$ | $182$ | $200$ |
| Factory Y | $32$ | $168$ | $200$ |
| Total | $50$ | $350$ | $400$ |

A product is selected at random and found to be defective. What is the probability that it was produced by Factory Y?

A survey asked 58 students about their preferred sport. The results are shown in the table below.

| | Soccer | Swimming | Track | Total |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 9th grade | 17 | 8 | 6 | 31 |
| 10th grade | 9 | 13 | 5 | 27 |
| Total | 26 | 21 | 11 | 58 |

If a student is selected at random from those in 10th grade, what is the probability that the student prefers swimming?

The function $g$ is a linear function. The table below shows selected values of $g$.

| $x$ | $g(x)$ |
|---|---|
| $-2$ | $17$ |
| $3$ | $2$ |
| $11$ | $-22$ |

For what value of $x$ does $g(x) = -7$?

The table below shows the number of books read during a semester by each of 20 students.

| Number of books | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ | $5$ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Frequency | $2$ | $5$ | $6$ | $4$ | $2$ | $1$ |

What is the mean number of books read per student?

A teacher recorded quiz scores and their frequencies as shown below.

| Score | Frequency |
|---|---|
| $17$ | $3$ |
| $23$ | $5$ |
| $31$ | $x$ |
| $38$ | $4$ |
| $46$ | $2$ |

The total number of scores is $14 + x$. If the median score is $31$, what is the least possible value of $x$?

A company surveyed 150 employees about their commute method and department. The results are shown in the table below.

| | Marketing | Engineering | Total |
|---|---|---|---|
| Drive | 31 | 42 | 73 |
| Transit | 19 | 23 | 42 |
| Bike | 14 | 21 | 35 |
| Total | 64 | 86 | 150 |

Given that a randomly selected employee is in the Engineering department, what is the probability that this employee bikes to work?

The linear function $g$ is defined for all real numbers. The table below shows selected values of $g$.

| $x$ | $g(x)$ |
|---|---|
| $-4$ | $31$ |
| $2$ | $7$ |
| $5$ | $-5$ |

What is the value of $g(13)$?

A team of nutritional scientists at the University of Groningen studied the relationship between fermented food consumption and gut microbiome diversity in 1,247 adults over a fourteen-month period. Participants who consumed at least three servings of fermented foods per week—such as kefir, sauerkraut, or kimchi—showed a statistically significant increase in gut microbial species richness compared to a control group that maintained their usual diet. The researchers concluded that regular fermented food consumption directly enhances gut microbiome diversity. However, the study relied on self-reported dietary logs, and participants were not randomly assigned to diet groups.

The following table summarizes key characteristics of the two groups at baseline:

| Characteristic | Fermented-food group (n=623) | Control group (n=624) |
|---|---|---|
| Mean age (years) | 34.2 | 51.7 |
| Median daily fiber intake (g) | 31.4 | 18.9 |
| Percentage exercising >150 min/week | 72% | 38% |
| Percentage taking probiotic supplements | 8% | 7% |

A company surveyed $150$ employees about their commuting method. The results are shown in the table below.

| | Drive | Transit | Bike | Total |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Full-time | $47$ | $31$ | $12$ | $90$ |
| Part-time | $23$ | $19$ | $18$ | $60$ |
| Total | $70$ | $50$ | $30$ | $150$ |

If a randomly selected employee from the survey uses transit, what is the probability that the employee is part-time?

A researcher records the following data, where $x$ represents the number of years since $2010$ and $y$ represents a town's population in hundreds.

| $x$ | $0$ | $5$ | $10$ | $15$ |
|-----|-----|-----|------|------|
| $y$ | $200$ | $310$ | $482$ | $749$ |

Which of the following function types best models the relationship between $x$ and $y$?

A biologist records the population of bacteria (in thousands) at various hours after the start of an experiment.

| Hours | $0$ | $3$ | $6$ | $9$ | $12$ |
|-------|-----|-----|-----|-----|------|
| Population | $5$ | $14$ | $40$ | $113$ | $320$ |

Which of the following function types best models the relationship between hours and population?

The table below shows the distribution of 83 employees at a company by department and handedness.

|              | Left-handed | Right-handed | Total |
|--------------|-------------|--------------|-------|
| Engineering  | 11          | 38           | 49    |
| Marketing    | 7           | 27           | 34    |
| Total        | 18          | 65           | 83    |

If one right-handed employee is selected at random, what is the probability that the employee works in Marketing?

The table below shows the number of hours $13$ students spent studying for an exam.

| Hours | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ | $5$ | $7$ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Frequency | $1$ | $4$ | $3$ | $3$ | $2$ |

What is the mean number of hours spent studying, rounded to the nearest tenth?

A two-way frequency table summarizes the lunch preferences of $83$ employees at a company.

|  | Salad | Sandwich | Soup | Total |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Morning shift | $11$ | $17$ | $7$ | $35$ |
| Afternoon shift | $13$ | $19$ | $16$ | $48$ |
| Total | $24$ | $36$ | $23$ | $83$ |

If an employee is selected at random from those who prefer soup, what is the probability that the employee works the morning shift?

The function $f$ is linear, and the table below shows selected values.

| $x$ | $f(x)$ |
|---|---|
| $-3$ | $41$ |
| $1$ | $17$ |
| $k$ | $-7$ |

What is the value of $k$?

A class of 23 students took a quiz scored from 0 to 10. The scores are summarized below:

| Score | 3 | 5 | 6 | 7 | 8 | 9 | 10 |
|-------|---|---|---|---|---|---|----|
| Frequency | 1 | 3 | 4 | 6 | 5 | 3 | 1 |

If the student who scored 3 retakes the quiz and scores 8 instead, which of the following correctly describes the change in the mean and the median?

A two-way frequency table summarizes the lunch preferences of 130 employees at a company.

|  | Vegetarian | Non-vegetarian | Total |
|---|---|---|---|
| Morning shift | 18 | 37 | 55 |
| Afternoon shift | 29 | 46 | 75 |
| Total | 47 | 83 | 130 |

If an employee is selected at random from those who prefer vegetarian lunches, what is the probability that the employee works the afternoon shift?

The table below shows the number of hours $21$ students spent volunteering last month.

| Hours | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ | $5$ | $6$ | $7$ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Frequency | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ | $6$ | $3$ | $2$ | $1$ |

If one student who volunteered for $4$ hours is removed from the data set, which of the following statistics will change?

plain.text:
The system of equations below has two solutions, $(x_1, y_1)$ and $(x_2, y_2)$.
$$y = x^2 - 4x + 1$$
$$y = 2x - 7$$
What is the value of $x_1 + x_2$?
A factory produces $240$ widgets in $6$ hours. At this same constant rate, how many widgets would the factory produce in $10$ hours?
In the $xy$-plane, line $p$ passes through the point $(3, 5)$ and is perpendicular to the line $2x + 3y = 12$. What is the $y$-intercept of line $p$?
Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
The student wants to emphasize a disadvantage of green roofs. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
A contractor charges a flat fee of $\$120$ plus $\$45$ per hour of labor. If the total charge for a job was $\$570$, how many hours of labor were required?
A line is perpendicular to $y = dfrac{2}{3}x + 1$ and passes through the point $(6, 4)$. What is the $y$-intercept of this line?
A bakery models its daily production cost in dollars with the function $C(x) = 8x + 50$, where $x$ is the number of cakes produced. What does the number $8$ represent in this function?
Two phone plans are modeled by the functions $f(x) = 25x + 40$ and $g(x) = 15x + 90$, where $x$ is the number of months. After how many months will the two plans have the same total cost?

A manufacturer requires that the temperature $T$, in degrees Celsius, of a chemical solution satisfy $-2 \leq dfrac{3T - 9}{3} \leq 5$. Which of the following correctly describes the allowable range of temperatures?

What is the value of $x$ in the solution to the system of equations below?
$$2x + y = 7$$
$$x - y = 2$$
A store sells notebooks for $\$3$ each and pens for $\$2$ each. A customer buys a total of 14 items and spends $\$33$. How many notebooks does the customer buy?
